objective: Proof, written before the run: a knot-local move attaches a cone over the graph of the pairs its knots use; the second Betti number of the knot complex never falls; from a bracketing it is zero exactly until the first fill, which also makes the first crossing; so no two splits cross iff the knots close no cycle.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): a knot-local move attaches a cone over the graph of its old pairs (b2 never falls; b1 grows when the pairs do not touch); a filled knot forces a crossing in any presentation; along KF3, NN, NN2 and SEEDK from a bracketing, no crossing, no filled knot, b2 = 0 and no fill yet are equivalent at every step; b2 depends on the presentation.
title: The first closed set of knots is the first crossing
